sql: SELECT o.buyer_id,o.timestamp,o.order_id,o.meal_id,o.order_state,d.deliverer_id FROM orders o JOIN delivery d ON o.buyer_id=d.buyer_id AND o.timestamp=d.timestamp WHERE (o.buyer_id=1 AND o.timestamp='2026-11-15 21:47:32') OR (o.buyer_id=4 AND o.timestamp='2026-11-15 21:47:32') OR (o.buyer_id=1 AND o.timestamp='2026-11-15 21:47:33') ORDER BY o.buyer_id,o.timestamp,o.order_id
